digest.component_or_area: CLI parser framework and help generation
propositions: Command syntax is currently split across multiple sources (imperative argv loops, inline argparse, 54 hand-maintained help files, 22 curated descriptions) allowing parser, runtime help, and documentation to disagree
A unified argparse factory protocol and registry is needed to establish a single source of truth for all command grammars and prevent command-census drift
Generated canonical help and grouped overview must be byte-deterministic and serve as the authoritative source before top-level routing and operation boundaries

All command-family parsers must be migrated from imperative/inline construction to pure side-effect-free factory implementations with verified argv parity (accept/reject, diagnostics, exit codes, streams)
Backward compatibility must be preserved through derived exports and the existing execution ladder, with rollback capability at the parser-family level
